question: In August 2023, Which of the following former Chief Justice of India was appointed a member of Singapore's International Mediator Panel?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NV Ramana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NV Ramana** was appointed as a member of Singapore's International Mediator Panel in August 2023.
 
• He served as the 48th Chief Justice of India from April 24, 2021, to August 26, 2022.
 
• His appointment to the International Mediator Panel highlights his extensive experience and expertise in the field of law and mediation.
 
• The International Mediator Panel in Singapore consists of distinguished mediators from around the world who assist in resolving international disputes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice NV Ramana** has been recognized for his contributions to the Indian judiciary, including his efforts to make the judicial system more accessible and efficient.
 
• During his tenure as Chief Justice, he emphasized the importance of judicial accountability and transparency.
 
• The Singapore International Mediation Centre (SIMC) is known for its high standards and effectiveness in resolving cross-border disputes.
 
• Justice Ramana's appointment is a testament to the strong bilateral relations between India and Singapore in the legal and judicial sectors.
